# $crav1-refresh-system-notes

lane: cross-cutting | group: Keep the picture current | starter: no | stage: stable | since: 1.8.0 | prompts: 0
purpose: Update the picture in docs/system/ when something was added: add what is new to the short description, the diagram, and how the parts connect, and do not rewrite what is there.
use_when: Something was added; catch the picture up
reads: Reads the picture and what a spec already states.
writes: Writes new lines on the short description, the context diagram, and how the parts connect. When this run reads a whole repo, sets that repo's `Synced at` line in `repos.md` and touches only those repos. When this run reads only one slice, leaves the repos.md Synced at lines alone and writes or updates `Synced at: <repo> <branch>@<short sha>, <date>` on that slice's `spec.md`. Reading specs does not set it. A consumer measuring drift uses the older of the `## Synced at` section of `repos.md` and the slice line, and an empty value means unknown, so fall back to spec file commit dates. When pointed at an updated note in `docs/research/`, checks each listed point and clears, narrows, or routes it. An older mark with no point lines is split into the hits it was made from. It also routes the note's own open questions when the answer lies outside the note's owner, including when the mark clears. It does not ask the user.
leaves alone: Leaves existing picture lines, glossary rows, design, build, and the `docs/notes/` layout alone (1.85.0, no flat-notes migration prompt).
limits: spark, ideas, intake, match, match-dump, and add-to-spec run this picture update on the pass that appends a glossary row. Existing-to-specs updates the picture in its own pass. Build-features, fix-bug, fix-build-gaps, read-environment, and the add-to-spec handoffs from read-environment and suggest-tests-for-code may ask and do not run this command. Build-tasks and build-tasks do not ask. It does not commit a cleared research mark.
flow:
- When something was added, **`$crav1-refresh-system-notes`** updates the short description, the diagram, and how the parts connect.
- Some commands ask at the end of the run whether to run it, and do not run it: `$crav1-build-features` when a slice is marked done or retired, `$crav1-fix-bug` and `$crav1-fix-build-gaps` when the fix changes how the parts connect, `$crav1-read-environment` after marks lines are added, and `$crav1-add-to-spec` once at the end of a read-environment or suggest-tests handoff.
- `$crav1-build-tasks` do not ask.
called_by: Called by the user and by `$crav1-read-environment` for a confirmed system section.
runs by itself: Calls no skill.
you run next: $crav1-finalize-commit
first: `$crav1-refresh-system-notes @docs/system/ @docs/specs/ Add what the specs already state to the picture. Do not rewrite what is already there. Do not write code.`
walkthrough: from-refresh-system-notes.md
human: https://github.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/blob/v1.206.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-refresh-system-notes.md
